answer.reason: The UNESCO UIS modelled estimate for the upper secondary completion rate in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD) in 2023 is 23.42%, which corresponds to option A. The alternative value (25.51%) matches a different record in the dataset rather than the COD entry.
